title: Chisco
description: Chisco is a Chinese imagined speech EEG dataset recorded from five participants (sub-01 to sub-05) across 5-6 sessions each on separate days. It provides raw EEG recordings, preprocessed data in fif and pkl formats, and the text stimuli used to elicit imagined speech. The dataset supports research on brain-computer interfaces and decoding of imagined language.
methods_description: Participants completed 5-6 sessions over separate days, imagining Chinese sentences presented as text stimuli while EEG was recorded and saved in EDF format. Preprocessed derivatives are provided as fif and pkl files.

funding_references.funder_name: National Natural Science Foundation of China
